problem.title: Split String into Descending Consecutive Values
problem.problemStatement: Given a string consisting of digits, determine whether it can be split into two or more non-empty substrings such that the numerical values are in strictly descending order and differ by exactly 1. Return true if possible; otherwise return false.
problem.output: true if such a split exists, otherwise false.
